publication_gate.reason: Complete power/horizontal/flyback path is not implemented; accepted entries cover only the neck bench.

limitations: Only the 012-6891 neck board is connected; horizontal, vertical and power stages remain unimplemented.
External ideal bench supplies exercise a stage, not the complete monitor.
Device and C2 bounds are engineering assumptions, not measured confidence intervals.
No electron emission, heater dynamics or spark-gap discharge is included in this electrical stage.
External supply impedance and constant tube load are assumptions; no complete power/horizontal model.
Fault predictions have not been validated against a real monitor.
Feature windows describe settled levels. Transition-only faults may be indistinguishable in these features.
Intervals summarize sampled assumptions, not guaranteed bounds or diagnostic probabilities.
Held-out parameter cases use the same model; they are not hardware validation.
No screen symptom, automatic diagnosis or live measurement instructions are inferred.
